method.name: poppler_pdftoppm_original_page_crop
method.coordinates: crop_box_pt is [left, top, right, bottom] in PDF points (1/72 inch), origin top-left of the unrotated page; raster_crop_px is [x, y, width, height] at 216 dpi. These are page-image crop coordinates, NOT field coordinates.
method.output: PNG, original PDF RGB rendering on white background; no redraw, synthesized labels, coordinate overlay, color edits, rotation, warping or perspective correction.
method.crop_rule: Union of the complete original figure image bbox and its complete original caption text bbox, plus 4 PDF points on the left and right. Top/bottom kept at that union to exclude adjacent prose/figures. Integer pixel bounds use floor(left/top) and ceil(right/bottom).

calibration.warning: Official rulebook illustration only. This crop includes the original walls, image whitespace and figure caption. Neither crop bounds nor image pixels define the playable field bounds, origin, axes, scale or a camera/world projection. The source page 4.1 also explicitly states that renderings are illustrative.
